When the internet discusses socialjustice, especially in a community, it usually goes either 2 ways:

  1. A community that while caring about social problems (which is a good thing) is shut off from dissenting oppinions and ignores the problems of the less oppressed, if not supporting more oppression of them out of emotional turmoil. This is not good, because this brings just as many problems to the table as it solves.

  2. A community that does nothing but call the other group of people out and point out the problems of the groups they ignored.

Let's make a community that cares about every group, no matter who is more oppressed or who is oppressing the other more. No emphasis on either.

The groundwork for this Subverse should be laid out by the community, but my proposal is:

  1. This is a place of learning, not a safespace. True understanding comes from the ability to speak one's mind, having a civil discussion, and keeping an open mind. It is easy to let ones anger of injustice and past events consume oneself and block out other thought, but that is a path that often cuts off oneself to the truth. It is very easy for people from different walks of life to see things in different ways. Observing someone is one thing, being in their shoes is another. Both parties should try to understand before they sling mud. Don't upvote/downvote based on whether you agree. If a bigot posts, don't shut them down or contact a mod, reason with them. Not everyone has an open mind, but it's better than outright censoring them.

  2. Every group has problems, even if some groups have more. For example: Women have yet to get into some higher positions of power, and are few in many fields of work. They have to live up to rediculous beauty standards that men don't have to, and have to deal with people wanting to get them drunk to fuck. However women can still get away with physically abusing their husbands and suing for child custody and child support over false charges, and in many occasions get a lower penalty for commiting the same crimes as men. We don't have to agree on the same things, maybe someone's statistics on an issue say other wise. Maybe prison should put more effort on rehabilitation than sentence. Maybe not. The point is, we are here to learn about people's grievances and share our own, learn in the process, and hopefully find ways to help each other and get shit done as a small part of the greater good. Hopefully we can do all this and not take too much pride in it (notice the emphasis, pride isn't necessarily a bad thing, it's only when it gets to your head).

  3. There is a difference between calling someone out and what some people deem as unjust harassment. Going through someones profile to downvote their comments is not cool. Sending someone a shit ton of email/pm's because you disagree with them isn't cool either. Posting someone's dox is horribly wrong and you will be permanently banned from this subverse if you dare try. However, making a post calling someone or a group out is not harassment, it's criticism. Our society needs criticism in order to improve and learn. Just because some criticism is wrong and misinformed doesn't mean criticism as a whole is wrong.

Hello golfers

I've just released the largest update for Unlimited Golf yet! Five new course types are now available, Volcanoes is an extension of the earth levels and is even more of a challenge than Extreme Mountains. It's essentially Ponds meets Extreme Mountains really. There is now also a parallel level campaign for space levels! These four new courses are unlocked separately from the original Earth levels. The first level is the Moon with less gravity, then Jupiter with more gravity. Next is the moon again with Asteroids hovering in the sky and the current last space course is Meteor Shower which features meteors that shoot across the sky and into the ground.

Since I wanted space levels to feel different and like space the physics have again faced some changes. These are all for the better and the game should feel better and make more sense overall. I am getting less annoying bounces and less rolls over the hole thankfully.

A friend's father was playing my game and had some trouble reading the text while golfing. Included in this update is an option for large gameplay font that will accommodate the glasses wearing crowd.

And since there were more levels I needed to fit more stats into the stat page, hence it has been redone. It is now easier to read and scroll able. This is great as it allows me to start recording and displaying more stats possibly in the future.

Thanks for reading and enjoy the update!
